asr.full_text: Hello and welcome to another update video on AVEX. So AVEX got requested by some of our members, so i thought i'd break it down with you all here on Youtube. It is a chart which is in a downtrend of course. Right, so we've been in a downtrend for quite some time. We're currently testing those previous swing lows from 2023. We do have a five- wave decline into the 2023 low Depends on I mean I could label it as complete down here in 2022 or even 2023 it really doesn't have a major, you know major impact doesn't make a great difference The blue count is clearly the leading count at the moment which suggests lower prices in a diagonal pattern Wave 1 was a 3 wave move move, wave 2 as well. Then wave 3 should be an ABC structure. We could get a wave 4 soon, and then a fifth wave to the downside. I could view the C wave as complete or nearly complete. What I normally do is if I look at the ABC structure like that, have we reached standard targets? And yes. Look, the chart has reached the standard target zone for a C wave between the 100% extension and 161.8 extension. In addition to that I will check, okay this is targets internally, but is the third wave long enough? Which means normally I wanted to reach the 138 percent extension of the wave 1. And yeah, also here we've just reached it, 8 90. So we are where we need to be to complete the third wave, which doesn't mean that the fourth wave has to start, but it means that the third wave has done what it needed to do, and that absolutely we could get the start of the fourth wave here. It's just that probabilities will start to shift. And if we look at the microstructures, I could even label five waves down in the c wave. Again, that doesn't mean that the c wave couldn't get maybe one more low. But we're talking about okay, the high probability element of the ABC structure to the downside is done from a structural point of view. Which means lower is possible but not needed any more. If we now get a larger bounce which has to be expected, you know, this could be a wave 4 this could be aligned with the B wave that we're tracking on the Bitcoin chart. But it's not clearly started yet. Right? That's the problem. So I'm waiting here for clearer evidence that a wave 4 bounce starts 1360 to 1977 is resistance. So for example, that means wave 4 could easily get to $14. I shouldn't say easily, but it could get to $14, $15, $16 maybe in this way for. And bear in mind, because we're dealing with a diagonal pattern, it could be quite a stretched out wave 4, which would then probably align really well with Bitcoin's um with Bitcoin's b wave and if we look at the shorter time frame it is like, on the Bitcoin chart it's it's super choppy here right now uh i mean if it if it started to move up yeah then it's something like this a b see we might even be in the B wave still, yeah? This is getting quite complex at the moment also on the Bitcoin chart and then we might see something like that. This is how the wave four could move higher. The only support area, here, I can offer really, is based on the rally that happened after the six of February low. And so this would be our range support between $7.90 and $8.43. And we might test support once more. It could be a very complex A B C, for those who are interested in the micro, yeah. So it looks like we're gonna see another test of support and this would be a support zone to watch below 7.90. It will become more probable that we already have a top and we're going to get another extension lower in wave three. Okay, so that can even easily happen so there is not a lot of risk and the idea that the wave 4 started well. So that's a thing about low confidence anyway. We're just dealing with a range here yeah so i keep you updated about any changes hope you enjoyed the update uh make sure you um subscribe and also in case you're interested in additional updates charts news and much more i recommend that you also follow on the x channel more crypto online i put the link into the comment section you can get a lot of additional updates charts news also avax maybe here and there a little bit more regularly so check it out thanks so much have a great day bye
